about: Abd al-Baqi numbers the pinned turath export (book 1681) prints in another way. Each was found by the build and checked against Abd al-Baqi's numbering as the fawazahmed0 hadith-api ara-bukhari edition carries it (the same text under the number). See scripts/hadith/buildSahihayn.ts.

starts.6896: وَقَالَ لِي ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى
